rationale: Keep the sole Switch record and complete its active ownership roster. Preserve DigitalBridge/DBP II and IFM/GIF, record the latest comparable 55.8%/37.2%/7.0% schedule across DigitalBridge, IFM and the management rollover group, and add Aware Super as a current co-investor with an explicitly non-additive undisclosed stake. InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and neither the reported confidential IPO filing nor the pending SoftBank-DigitalBridge manager transaction changes Switch's ownership periods.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Switch, Inc. develops, owns and operates large-scale U.S. data-center campuses serving AI, cloud and enterprise customers. The platform was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, with campuses in Nevada, Texas, Michigan and Georgia and a Pennsylvania expansion announced in 2026. DigitalBridge Partners II and IFM Global Infrastructure Fund completed the take-private on December 6, 2022. The latest comparable ownership schedule reports DigitalBridge at 55.8%, IFM at 37.2% and the management rollover group at 7.0%. Aware Super is also a current co-investor, but its exact stake, vehicle, closing date and nesting are not publicly disclosed and are not additive to that schedule. InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no later signed or closed direct Switch transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
